properties.name: British Columbia and Alberta south of 54°N
properties.source: Owner, Oct 12: BC's and Alberta's northern border is the same line as Manitoba-Saskatchewan's, 54°N; north of it is land in no shetach. Only the province's own land is cut by it. The furthest-north centre in either province is Edmonton (53.5°N). Alberta no longer takes the Yukon and NWT south of 63°N.
